model.src:
(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (message Request (sketch "A request."))
  (message Event (sketch "A event."))
  (message Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (message Command (sketch "A command."))
  (message Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port :in Event :as keep) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port :out Snapshot :as metric) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (block ShadowRouter
      (implements Observable)
      (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
    (block RetryParser
      (port :out Snapshot :as done)
      (implements Durable)
      (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
      (level
        (block RemoteIndex
          (port :out Receipt :as emit)
          (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
        (block RetryMetrics
          (port :out Command :as emit)
          (implements Durable)
          (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
        (block RemoteCache
          (port :in Request :as evt)
          (port :out Event)
          (implements Observable)
          (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
          (level
            (block Cache
              (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
            (block ShadowSearch
              (port :in Command :as evt)
              (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
            (adjacent
              (block BatchCatalog
                (port :out Receipt :as done)
                (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
              (block LiveSession
                (port :in Event :as evt)
                (port :out Command :as emit)
                (implements Durable)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block Editor
                (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))
          (level
            (block ShadowQueue
              (port :out Receipt :as done)
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))))))
  (level
    (block LocalBilling
      (port :in Receipt :as evt)
      (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
      (level
        (adjacent
          (block BatchUploader :type "Process"
            (implements Durable)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block Metrics
                  (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
                (block ShadowLedger
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block RemoteRenderer
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block RemoteMailer :type "Feature"
                  (port :in Request)
                  (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))))
          (block RetryAuth
            (port :in Request :as req)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
            (level
              (block RemoteQueue
                (port :in Receipt :as req)
                (port :out Command)
                (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))
          (block ShadowMailer
            (port :out Request :as emit)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block EdgeEditor :type "Service"
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block RemoteSearch :type "Store"
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block LiveQueue
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))))
          (block RemoteFeed
            (port :in Event :as req)
            (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))
        (adjacent
          (block Mailer
            (port :in Event :as evt)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
          (block EdgeSync :type "Feature"
            (port :in Request :as evt)
            (port :out Receipt :as done)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
          (block BatchPlanner
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
          (block ShadowPricing :type "Store"
            (port :out Event :as done)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))
        (block RemoteParser :type "Feature"
          (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))
      (level
        (block RetryMailer
          (port :out Event)
          (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
          (level
            (block LiveFeed
              (port :out Event :as emit)
              (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
            (block BatchInbox
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
            (block EdgeAudit
              (port :out Command)
              (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))
          (level
            (block RemoteAudit
              (port :in Event :as req)
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Thin wrapper."))))))))
